capability_vocabulary.basis: V5 §118.1 — Full/Limited/Read-only occur only in per-role Level and per-administrator Access columns, never in the Area x Verb grid; and the three ph- icons are bound to status pills elsewhere, not to capability cells.
capability_vocabulary.consequence: A grant is the presence of a row in admin_role_capabilities; its absence is a denial. Migration 153 needs no schema change.
